tasks.description: Read and write the signed-in owner's reminder hour through the accepted typed profile HTTP routes.
constraints: Forward Swift client transport only. Return an exact unified Git diff in JSON with separate headers, controller applies. No UI, scheduler, LocalStore, outbox, server, notification claim or live test changes.

Live plants-api v28 established GET /me returns {profile:{preferred_locale,reminder_hour_local}} and POST /commands profile.update returns that profile plus SQL watermark. Request includes no plant target, event UUID in operation_id and associated header, payload_json contains only reminder_hour_local integer 0...23. A repeated call may use the same typed envelope. Do not decode this small private response as SyncWireProfileDTO whose wider fields are required.

Use the existing session-bound SyncSessionLease read/send transport, strict 0...23/en or pl and SQL timestamp validators, explicit session/cancel guard before and after HTTP. UTC watermark does not imply local timezone changes. Reject malformed or wrong-hour receipt. Add focused CollectionWireTests for exact authenticated requests, client-side bounds, stale/mismatched receipt, no owner change/cancel acceptance and valid exact retry. T083/T084 open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift compile/unit gate confirms owner-bound profile settings and typed payload.
